title: Lodash
description: A modern JavaScript utility library delivering modularity and performance.

data.text: Lodash is a utility library that simplifies common programming tasks with arrays, objects, strings, and numbers. It offers both full builds and individual function imports for tree-shaking.

data.title: Installation
data.code:
npm install lodash
# or
yarn add lodash

data.title: Common Utilities
data.content: Use Lodash for array and object manipulation.

data.title: Tree Shaking
data.text: Import individual functions like import get from 'lodash/get' to reduce bundle size.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Supports modular imports for smaller bundles
Widely used in legacy and modern codebases
data.takeaway: Lodash remains a reliable choice for common data manipulation tasks.
